comments.body:
RED -> GREEN proven against the repo's own owner of this invariant.

RED (marker deleted, no guard added):

  tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py::test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked
  E  .github/workflows/_optionality.yml :: [terraform-config-inspect-canary]
     'Run the opt-in pinned canary' runs tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py
     with no `-f` guard and no marker
  1 failed, 8 passed

So the guard test detects this exact step and path; the `# predates-gate-ok:` marker was the
only thing keeping it quiet.

GREEN (canonical `[ -f ]` guard + skip message added, marker gone): 9 passed, including
test_empty_tree_every_guarded_step_skips_cleanly, which executes every guarded body in an
empty directory.

Direct behavioural check of the edited step body:
  EMPTY TREE  rc=0  prints "…not in checked-out tree (change predates the gate) — skipping;
                            the gate re-enforces on rebase and on every post-merge change"
  REAL TREE   rc=0  falls through to the canary (skip branch NOT taken)
so the canary keeps full teeth on every current tree.

Scope note: this ticket fixes ONLY the exit-4-on-pre-gate-trees manifestation (change 2673).
The same job also fails on trees that DO contain the file, with
`assert 'abstain' == 'match'` from test_pinned_upstream_canary (change 2674, base 0033662b5534).
That is a different mechanism — the producer schema cannot validate the real pinned binary —
and is filed separately as widish-chemic-goitered (f95d-19f6-7e58-4a8e). `go install` is NOT
failing in that job: its step logs ten successful module downloads and the test's `has_binary`
guard passed; the "go install silently failed" string in the log is pytest's source listing in
the traceback context, not the assertion that fired.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The `optionality (lean-runtime + packaging on the patchset) / terraform-config-inspect pinned
canary` job fails with

```
ERROR: file or directory not found: tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py
##[error]Process completed with exit code 4
```

on any Gerrit patchset whose base predates commit `59d504c2bdbb`, which added that test file.
Observed on Gerrit change 2673 (an unrelated reconciler test-identity fix) in
`https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33960223401/job/101291408179`, and again in run
`33960280894`. Both took `Verified -1` for a job that has nothing to do with the change under
review. The blast radius is every open change branched before 2026-09-05T10:09:42Z, and it recurs
for every future change branched before the file landed — so the cost is not "one rebase", it is a
standing tax on the review queue. That is why this is priority 1.

## Provenance

Introduced by commit `59d504c2bdbb` ("Add terraform-config-inspect corroborator", Gerrit change
2672), which added both the canary job and the test file it names. That change is another
session's and is already merged; this ticket fixes forward on `main` and does not amend it, and it
does not rebase anyone else's patchset.

## Root cause

`gerrit-verify.yaml` states the governing property in its own header comment (lines 23-27): "This
workflow is dispatched from `main`, so GitHub stamps every run's `head_sha` with the sha of THIS
FILE — then the job checks out a Gerrit patchset ref." The workflow DEFINITION therefore comes
from `main` while the checked-out TREE is the patchset. A step that names a repo-local path added
by `main` runs against trees that do not contain it.

rebar already owns this invariant. `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` requires that
every CI step running a repo-local gate file either guards that exact file with
`[ -f <path> ]` plus the canonical skip message `change predates the gate`, or carries a
`# predates-gate-ok: <reason>` marker. `_optionality.yml` itself already applies the guard three
steps earlier, at lines 128-140, with a comment naming the identical failure mode
(bug `1909-c1a7-9f20-440f`, bug `5bc6-5496-4e17-403a`): "on a tree whose base predates it pytest
collects nothing and exits 4 — a Verified -1 caused by the gate rather than by the change under
review".

The canary step escaped that guard by asserting a marker whose reason is factually wrong
(`.github/workflows/_optionality.yml:334`):

```
# predates-gate-ok: the terraform-config-inspect-canary job and this test file are introduced
together in REB-640 c6ce, so the lane never runs against an older base that lacks
tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py
```

"Introduced together" would be sufficient if the job definition and the tree came from the same
commit. On the Verified lane they do not, exactly as `gerrit-verify.yaml:23-27` documents. The
marker silenced a guard that was correct.

This is a DIFFERENT root cause from the sibling flake on ticket `persuasive-welcome-nymph`
(`5310-b51f-bba6-4e61`), which is a wall-clock race inside the test's own fixture. Same
provenance commit, same file named, two independent defects: this one is a definition-vs-tree
skew in a CI step, that one is a timing race in a test harness. Linked `relates_to`, not
`duplicates`.

## Approach

Replace the false marker with the guard the repo already standardises on, copying the idiom
verbatim from the sibling step at `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml:134-140`: an early
`if [ ! -f tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py ]; then echo "... (change predates
the gate) — skipping; the gate re-enforces on rebase and on every post-merge change"; exit 0; fi`
placed BEFORE the `pip install`, so a pre-gate tree costs no install time, and delete the
`# predates-gate-ok:` line.

This is the right approach rather than, say, adding `--ignore-missing` or relaxing the pytest exit
code, because the guard is the invariant this repo already owns and tests: a single convention
with one enforcing test, whose skip message is asserted to appear on stdout. It also preserves the
canary's teeth on every current tree — the step still runs the real pinned binary against the real
test whenever the file is present, which is every post-merge change and every rebased patchset.

## Scope

- `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` — in the `terraform-config-inspect-canary` job's "Run the
  opt-in pinned canary" step, drop the `# predates-gate-ok:` marker and add the canonical
  `[ -f ]` guard plus skip message ahead of the install.

## Testing

- RED: `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py -q` currently PASSES only because the
  marker suppresses the completeness check. Deleting the marker line alone (guard not yet added)
  must make `test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked` FAIL naming
  `tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py`, proving the guard test detects this exact
  step. Record the failure text.
- GREEN: with the guard added, both halves pass —
  `test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked` and
  `test_empty_tree_every_guarded_step_skips_cleanly`, the latter executing the new step body in an
  empty directory and requiring exit 0 with `change predates the gate` on stdout.
- Failure/absent path, direct: run the edited step's shell body verbatim in an empty temporary
  directory and assert it exits 0 and prints the skip message — the pre-gate tree case that
  produced the `-1` on change 2673.
- Present-tree path: run the same body in the worktree (where the file exists) and confirm it does
  NOT take the skip branch, so the canary is not silently disabled on current trees.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` no longer contains a `predates-gate-ok` marker in the
      `terraform-config-inspect-canary` job; verified by
      `grep -n "predates-gate-ok" .github/workflows/_optionality.yml` returning no line inside
      that job.
- [ ] The canary step guards `tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py` with `[ -f ]`
      and the exact string `change predates the gate`, ahead of the `pip install`; verified by
      reading the step and by `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py -q` passing.
- [ ] RED evidence recorded as a ticket comment: with the marker removed and no guard,
      `test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked` fails naming the canary step and
      that test path.
- [ ] Executing the edited step body in an empty directory exits 0 and prints
      `change predates the gate`; executing it in the worktree does not take the skip branch.
- [ ] `make verify` is green in the worktree before the change is pushed to Gerrit.

file_impact.reason: Replace the false predates-gate-ok marker on the terraform-config-inspect canary step with the canonical [ -f ] guard plus the 'change predates the gate' skip message.
